tasks.keeps: Scope, organisation, phase plan and work split decisions

agents.does: Checks the draft execution plan against contract and owner procedures and lists missing required sections

tasks.keeps: WBS structure, coding decisions and P6 setup approval

agents.does: Drafts P6 activity code and cost code dictionaries from the approved WBS and area codes

tasks.keeps: Numbering procedure, workflows and distribution matrix decisions

agents.does: Checks Document Locator folders, type codes and workflows against the issued numbering procedure, listing mismatches

tasks.keeps: Register scope and approval of numbers and register changes

agents.does: Collects discipline deliverables lists, checks numbers against the rule, keeps planned and actual dates in step with P6

tasks.keeps: Estimating method, factors and the estimate itself

agents.does: Drafts capacity-factored cost tables from benchmark data, flagging every factor and escalation applied

tasks.keeps: Estimate basis, template content and quantity acceptance

agents.does: Sends QTO templates, basis and due dates to each discipline, tracks returns and chases late ones

tasks.keeps: Factors, pricing judgement and the estimate

agents.does: Builds the equipment-factored quantity sheet from the equipment list and budget quotes, flagging each factor

tasks.keeps: Unit rates, pricing and estimate sign-off

agents.does: Checks estimate quantities against the latest discipline MTOs and vendor quotes and lists differences

tasks.keeps: Budget allocation and control budget approval

agents.does: Maps approved estimate lines to WBS and cost codes into a draft control budget table

tasks.keeps: Schedule logic, durations and baseline approval

agents.does: Drafts engineering and procurement activity lists from the deliverables register and procurement plan for planner review

tasks.keeps: Approval of each P6 update and schedule judgement

agents.does: Carries PO award, drawing return and forecast delivery dates from the Purchasing DB into a P6 update
Flags vendor forecast dates that erode float or pass need dates on the critical path

tasks.keeps: Rules of credit and validation of reported progress

agents.does: Computes deliverable progress by rules of credit from Document Locator status and drafts the earned value update
Checks document statuses claimed for credit against issued revisions in Document Locator

tasks.keeps: Critical path judgement and recovery proposals

agents.does: Runs float and critical path comparison against last period and drafts the look-ahead and slippage list

tasks.keeps: Forecasts, cost judgement and cost report issue

agents.does: Drafts cost report tables and narrative from commitment and actuals exports, citing the source of each figure

tasks.keeps: Impact estimates, change notice decisions and approvals

agents.does: Lists downstream tasks, documents and systems affected by each trend to support impact estimating
Logs trends and change notices, tracks their approval status and reminds owners of open items

tasks.keeps: Gate package content, recommendation and presentation

agents.does: Checks every gate deliverable is issued at the required revision and lists gaps in the package
Records gate decisions and conditions and tracks each condition to close-out

tasks.keeps: Risk identification, ranking and contingency setting

agents.does: Records workshop risks and mitigations into the register and tracks mitigation actions with their owners

tasks.keeps: Interface agreement content, disputes and escalation

agents.does: Keeps the interface register, reminds owners before need dates and chases interface agreements to closure
Notifies interface owners when an exchanged item they rely on is revised

tasks.keeps: Issue authorisation and transmittal release

agents.does: Checks numbering, title block and metadata on each issue and builds transmittals from the distribution matrix

tasks.keeps: Comment resolution and the review status returned

agents.does: Routes documents per the review matrix, consolidates comment sheets, lists overdue reviews and chases reviewers

tasks.keeps: Hold causes, priorities and release decisions

agents.does: Tracks each hold by cause, owner and target date, reminds owners and reports overdue releases
Extracts HOLD clouds and notes from issued drawings to reconcile against the hold list

tasks.keeps: Seal decision and IFC release

agents.does: Checks each IFC document shows checked, approved and sealed status in Document Locator before release

tasks.keeps: Validation, messaging and issue of the owner report

agents.does: Compiles progress, cost, schedule, change, procurement and HSE figures into the draft report with sourced narrative

tasks.keeps: Validation of field quantities and approval of the P6 load

agents.does: Compiles installed quantities and IWP completion from iConstruct into a P6 progress update for approval

tasks.keeps: Handover acceptance and project close-out decisions

agents.does: Checks the final records index against the deliverables register and lists missing as-builts
Checks vendor data books and turnover records for completeness against the handover requirements
